facts.business: PS IT Infrastructure & Services Limited is engaged in IT infrastructure and services, including share investments and trading activities.

auditor.name: Rajesh Kumar Gokul Chandra & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Kolkata (FRN No. 323891E), now known as SGAJ & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: 1) Valuation of inventories of unquoted shares at cost subject to independent valuation (Note 33). 2) Balances of trade receivables, loans and advances, trade payables subject to confirmation (Note 34). 3) No actuarial valuation for employee retirement benefits (Note 26). 4) Investments/inventories in small cap non-liquid stocks valued at last traded price without provision for possible losses (Note 31). 5) Delay in demat transfer of shares sold/purchased during FY 2025-26 (Note 32). Material Uncertainty: Going concern dependent on successful completion of CIRP and NCLT approval of resolution plan (Note 42).

key_risks: Material uncertainty regarding going concern due to ongoing CIRP
Valuation uncertainty of unquoted shares and illiquid investments
Unconfirmed balances of trade receivables, loans, advances, and payables
Non-recognition of employee retirement benefit liabilities without actuarial valuation
Delay in demat transfer of shares transacted during the year
